data.revised_prompt: Create a small text-free editorial section-heading ornament as a reusable PNG asset. Transparent background. Restrained contemporary Chinese art-publication style using only deep muted ink green #304e46. Motif: a quiet compact horizontal brush gesture suggesting a folded mountain ridge, plus one small leaf or reed mark. Very sparse ink texture, generous negative space, clean margins. Centered isolated ornament, horizontal, secondary and understated, suitable beside live Chinese headings. No text, no Chinese characters, no Latin letters, no logo, no seal, no stamp, no border, no frame, no badge, no people, no landscape scene, no busy illustration, no gradients, no 3D, no poster layout. Minimal monochrome ink mark, elegant editorial detail.
